objective: One-school launch with campus boundaries, permanent student records, role-scoped learning and staged assessment/finance.
phase: Phase 2/3 — identity and core education increments in progress

tests.environment: Python 3.12 / Django 5.2 / SQLite. Fresh database migrations and demo seeding verified; production PostgreSQL not tested.
commands: DJANGO_DEBUG=true python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run — no changes
DJANGO_DEBUG=true python manage.py test — 48 tests passed
Fresh SQLite migrate + seed_demo twice — idempotent synthetic data

milestones.name: Foundation and academics
milestones.criteria: Clean SQLite migrations; school/year/campus/term constraints; migration drift check and admin maintenance schema pass.

milestones.name: Session auth and scoped portals
milestones.criteria: CSRF login, POST logout, password reset token flow, deactivation, active membership filtering and role dashboards pass HTTP tests.

milestones.name: Student identity and year progression
milestones.criteria: Registration/guardians, immutable IDs, contextual roll uniqueness, history, preview/admin confirmation, repeat/graduation and controlled re-admission pass model/service/HTTP tests.

milestones.name: Basic attendance and classwork
milestones.criteria: Assigned teacher roster attendance, duplicate prevention, student self submissions, revision history, grading and school/role denials pass tests.

milestones.name: Assessment and report cards
milestones.criteria: Question banks, attempt policies, objective/manual scoring, moderation, publication and transcript tests pass.

milestones.name: Fees and accounting
milestones.criteria: Decimal invoice/payment/receipt/reversal ledger reconciles and accountant scope tests pass.

milestones.name: Oversight and complete operations
milestones.criteria: Correction approvals, timetable/notices, settings, dashboards and batch workflows pass scoped acceptance tests.

milestones.name: Production pilot release
milestones.criteria: PostgreSQL, privacy/security, uploads, SMTP, backup restoration, accessibility and hosted pilot acceptance are evidenced.

limitations: The pilot runs locally with synthetic data. No hosted deployment or production readiness is claimed.
PostgreSQL, real SMTP delivery, rate limiting/MFA, private file uploads and backup restoration are not verified.
Application/approval intake, conditional and batch promotions, transfer and section-correction browser flows remain incomplete.
Attendance correction approvals, quizzes, examinations, report cards and finance are not implemented.
History and audit guards cover normal model/service/queryset paths; privileged raw SQL can bypass application guards. Production database controls and concurrency tests remain release work.
decisions: Django 5.2 modular monolith with same-origin templates and sessions; no React/API split, queues or caches for this pilot.
One permanent Student UUID and STU code; year-specific Enrollment stores roll number and preserved placement/history.
SchoolClass denotes Grade and Section is a year-bound SectionOffering. Campus may be null for a schoolwide offering; Term belongs to AcademicYear.
No blanket superuser access to private student/learning records. Active school roles and teacher/student relationships determine scope; sensitive student reads and changes are audited.
IELTS projects remain separate; school scoring will be implemented independently after their feasibility audit.
next_actions: Complete admissions application/decision workflow and batch/conditional promotion previews with conflict and rollback tests.
Add attendance correction approvals, student attendance history and overdue/completed learning dashboards.
Implement independent question-bank/attempt/scoring/exam/report-card module; use the recorded IELTS keep-separate boundary.
Implement Decimal-safe fee plans, invoices, payment/receipt/reversal ledger and accountant authorization tests.
Validate PostgreSQL, SMTP delivery, throttling/MFA, private uploads, backup restoration and hosted pilot acceptance before release.
